create.title: Create vault
create.subtitle: Your vault password encrypts local data with Argon2id and AES-256-GCM. It is not your Trezor PIN or seed passphrase.
create.presetHint: Normal is recommended. Paranoid uses more memory and unlocks slower.
create.wipe: Wipe local vault after 10 failed unlock attempts
create.wipeHint: Off by default. Enabling this destroys encrypted local data after 10 wrong passwords - seed recovery is the only way back.

unlock.title: Unlock vault
unlock.subtitle: Enter your vault password to decrypt local data.
unlock.forgot: Forgot password? Restore from your seed phrase (coming in the next phase). There is no password recovery.

shell.emptyPortfolios: No portfolios yet. Set up a seed, then add a chain portfolio.
shell.homeBody: Vault is unlocked. Create or restore a seed to start holding funds.
shell.homeBodyReady: Seed ready. Add software, Trezor, or watch-only portfolios from the sidebar.

seed.title: Seed wallet
seed.subtitle: One BIP39 master seed for this vault. Confirm backup before creating software portfolios.
seed.writeDown: Write these words offline. Never share them. Screenshots are blocked where possible.
seed.screenProtectNote: Selection is disabled here. OS-level screen capture blocking is not available from the webview - keep this window private.
seed.confirmed: I have backed up my seed

portfolio.name: Name
portfolio.watchHint: EVM addresses require picking the network above.
portfolio.trezorAddressHint: Paste the address after verifying it on your Trezor screen.
portfolio.verifyOnDevice: Verify address on Trezor when creating
portfolio.receiveHint: For Trezor portfolios, confirm the address on-device before sharing.
portfolio.reviewHint: Double-check the prefix and suffix of the destination address.

settings.title: Settings
settings.bip39Hint: Optional 25th word for software seed (advanced). Lost passphrase means lost funds.
settings.bip39ValueHint: Stored encrypted in the vault. Lost passphrase = lost funds.
settings.wipeHint: Destroy local vault after 10 wrong unlock attempts
settings.presetHint: Changing preset re-wraps the vault key and requires your password
settings.autolockHint: 0 means never auto-lock while unlocked (not recommended)
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Launch Opal when you sign in
settings.customRpcHint: Optional per-chain API base URLs. Leave blank for defaults.
settings.vaultBackupHint: Export copies the encrypted vault file. Import replaces the local vault and locks the session.
settings.importDone: Vault imported. Unlock again if needed.
